# Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources

<!-- Limit: 1 page. Required when the project uses key resources whose
     identity or validity could affect the research. Describe the METHODS you
     will use to authenticate them — not the resources themselves, and not
     standard reagents. Common key resources: cell lines, specialty chemicals,
     antibodies, and other biologics. Delete if none apply. -->

**Cell lines.** Source, and authentication method (e.g. STR profiling on
receipt and at defined passage intervals) plus mycoplasma testing cadence.

**Antibodies.** Vendor, catalog and lot, and validation for the specific
application (e.g. knockout/knockdown control, orthogonal method).

**Other key resources.** Method and frequency of verification.
